market.summary: Wall Street had its worst day since April 2025 and Asia is falling hard this morning, led by chip makers, on fears of tighter AI regulation after the Democrats' midterm win and doubts about AI spending. GIFT Nifty points to only a small fall, about 0.3-0.5%, helped by record-size foreign buying yesterday. Your holdings have no chip exposure, so this is a sentiment risk to the open rather than a hit to their business. Your stops work on closing prices, so an opening dip alone decides nothing.

points.text: US close 5 Nov: S&P 500 -4.4%, Nasdaq -5.5%, Dow -3.4%; the Philadelphia chip index fell 12.2%. The screener's Yahoo reading has VIX at 28.2.
Asia this morning: Kospi fell more than 8% and hit a circuit breaker, Nikkei down 6-8% depending on the report, Taiwan down more than 8%. Hang Seng was not reported in what I read.
GIFT Nifty 24,460 at 07:49 IST against the 24,536.60 Nifty close; another read had 24,424.50. US futures were mixed in Asian hours: Nasdaq 100 +1.4%, S&P 500 +0.44%, Dow -0.53%.
FIIs bought about Rs 15,000 Cr on 5 Nov, reported as their biggest one-day purchase in nearly six years. The DII figure was not found.
Brent about $99, on reports of new tanker attacks in West Asia. USD/INR 94.52 on the screener's 5 Nov reading.
No new tariff or Trump policy news appeared in the reports read this morning.

market.watch: Whether the Nifty holds near 24,400 after the open, whether FIIs keep buying, and the US jobs report tonight. Muhurat session Sun 8 Nov; market shut Tue 10 Nov.
